trajectory.content: Prove that the square root of 2 is irrational.

By contradiction: assume √2 = p/q in lowest terms. Then 2 = p²/q², so p² = 2q². Thus p² is even, so p is even. Write p = 2k. Then 4k² = 2q², so q² = 2k², meaning q is also even. This contradicts p/q being in lowest terms. Therefore √2 is irrational.
